description: This Java class 'EntityQuery' provides a fluent API for constructing and executing entity database queries within the Apache OFBiz framework. It supports setting query parameters such as select fields, conditions, ordering, pagination, caching, and date filtering, and offers methods to retrieve query results in various forms.

classes.name: EntityQuery
classes.description: A utility class for building and executing database queries on entities with a fluent API, supporting conditions, ordering, pagination, caching, and date filtering.

methods.name: use
methods.description: Creates a new EntityQuery instance for a given Delegator.

methods.name: select
methods.description: Sets the fields to be retrieved in the query, replacing any previous selection.

methods.name: from
methods.description: Sets the entity or dynamic view entity to query against.

methods.name: where
methods.description: Sets the WHERE clause condition(s) for the query, replacing previous conditions.

methods.name: having
methods.description: Sets the HAVING clause condition for the query.

methods.name: orderBy
methods.description: Sets the ORDER BY fields for the query.

methods.name: cursorForwardOnly
methods.description: Sets the result set to be forward-only.

methods.name: cursorScrollSensitive
methods.description: Sets the result set to be scroll-sensitive.

methods.name: cursorScrollInsensitive
methods.description: Sets the result set to be scroll-insensitive.

methods.name: fetchSize
methods.description: Sets the fetch size for the query.

methods.name: maxRows
methods.description: Sets the maximum number of rows to retrieve.

methods.name: offset
methods.description: Sets the offset for the query results.

methods.name: limit
methods.description: Sets the limit for the number of results.

methods.name: distinct
methods.description: Specifies that duplicate results should be eliminated.

methods.name: cache
methods.description: Enables or disables cache usage for the query.

methods.name: filterByDate
methods.description: Filters results to only include active records based on date fields.

methods.name: queryList
methods.description: Executes the query and returns a list of results.

methods.name: queryIterator
methods.description: Executes the query and returns an iterator over the results.

methods.name: queryBatchIterator
methods.description: Returns a batch iterator for the query.

methods.name: queryFirst
methods.description: Returns the first result of the query.

methods.name: queryOne
methods.description: Returns a single result, expecting exactly one match.

methods.name: queryCount
methods.description: Returns the count of matching records.

methods.name: getFieldList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of values for a specific entity field.

methods.name: queryPagedList
methods.description: Returns a paged list of results.
